Title: Diagnosis

Details:
- What the test does:
  - isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet opens COMPRESS-379.jar, gets the entry META-INF/maven/ (a directory), and asserts that ze.isUnixSymlink() is false.

- Relevant implementation:
  - ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink():
    - returns (getUnixMode() & UnixStat.LINK_FLAG) == UnixStat.LINK_FLAG;
  - ZipArchiveEntry.getUnixMode():
    - returns platform != PLATFORM_UNIX ? 0 : (int) ((getExternalAttributes() >> SHORT_SHIFT) & SHORT_MASK);
    - For UNIX platform entries, this extracts the upper 16 bits of external attributes as the Unix mode.
  - UnixStat constants:
    - LINK_FLAG = 0120000 (S_IFLNK)
    - DIR_FLAG = 040000 (S_IFDIR)
    - FILE_FLAG = 0100000 (S_IFREG)
    - PERM_MASK = 07777 (permission bits)

- What’s in the problematic archive:
  - The issue report mentions entries with Unix permissions 177777 (octal 0177777). That value sets:
    - All permission bits (07777)
    - And multiple file type bits (e.g., S_IFREG 0100000, S_IFDIR 040000, S_IFLNK 0120000) — i.e., “more than one flag is set.”
  - The directory META-INF/maven/ in COMPRESS-379.jar appears to have such invalid mode bits.

- Why the test fails:
  - isUnixSymlink() currently checks whether the LINK_FLAG bit is present at all:
    - (mode & 0120000) == 0120000
  - For a mode like 0177777, this condition is true because the link bit is among the bits set, even if other file type bits (directory, regular) are also set.
  - Therefore, isUnixSymlink() returns true for META-INF/maven/, contradicting the test’s expectation that it should be false when more than one file-type flag is set.

- Root cause:
  - The method isUnixSymlink() uses an insufficient condition: it checks for the presence of the S_IFLNK bit rather than determining the entry’s file type. In POSIX, the entry’s type is determined by masking the mode with the file-type mask S_IFMT (0170000) and comparing for equality.
  - Correct logic should be based on the type bits only, e.g., (mode & S_IFMT) == S_IFLNK, not just checking that the S_IFLNK bit is present. This prevents misclassification when multiple type bits are set (as in the broken 0177777 case).

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
